scope: One final core, Agent and pre-execution routing policy on all original 62 exposed query families; 29 unseen candidates remain sealed.
inputs: Original baseline saved business requests, source public entity fields and database documents. Restore Cart item IDs. New invocation/object/version coordinates are independently checked. Environmental clock and generated non-query result IDs may differ; explicitly audit them.
strategy: Freeze all plans and rejection reasons before runtime; no answer-based fallback or per-field success whitelist. Full/selective same plan, global switches and required evidence.
rejected_queries: Do not force execution. Retain planning rejection and use a fresh same-entry business capture under the frozen core to enumerate actual original-input target instances. No origin answer is asserted for rejected targets; distinguish this receipt from executing the rejected query plan.
source_oracle: Reviewed original business projections and raw current message, call, object, field and version facts; not TF dependency replay or MirrorTaint predictions.
received_mutations: Execution profile does not impose legacy read-only enforcement on incoming application collections. Unproved ownership effects keep affected state unknown; exact append member/content-version evidence remains checked. Legacy read-only contracts remain enforced.
unsupported_uuid: UUID JSON projection is not modeled. Both planning paths must reject a UUID target instead of accepting a plan whose target snapshot is absent.
failure_policy: Preserve initial HATEOAS activation failure, parallel Orders timeout, legacy read-only interference, UUID admission failure and scoring-coordinate correction separately. New algorithm changes require another freeze; scoring-only corrections may re-evaluate unchanged raw evidence.
performance: No new cost claim. Run Orders in isolation from other application startup workers to avoid cold-start interference with its original Future deadline.
